name: config-default
real_breakage: GET /api/products returns HTTP 500 — the default dataFile is data/catalog.json but the shipped file is data/products.json, so the real server ENOENTs with no env overrides
green_tests: tests/catalog.test.mjs injects CATALOG_DATA_FILE for the override test, asserts the (wrong) default verbatim, and loads products only from a test fixture path — the shipped default path is never exercised
